name: dental-clinic
description: Stomatologiya klinikasi: Telegram bot, Mini App va Admin Panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,mini,admin -c blue,green,magenta "node --watch src/index.js" "npm run dev -w mini-app" "npm run dev -w admin-panel"
scripts.build: npm run build -w mini-app && npm run build -w admin-panel
scripts.setup: prisma migrate deploy && prisma generate && node prisma/seed.js && npm run build
